h: A Few Bowling Pointers for the Shopping Crowd
p: After a few hours of trailing round the shops, you'll want your game to go smoothly, so here are a few quick tips. Choose a ball you can comfortably control rather than the heaviest one available. Look at the arrows on the lane rather than the pins at the end, as it's easier to aim at something closer. Keep a smooth swing and follow through towards your target. And remember not to cross the foul line, otherwise that shot won't count.

Scoring works like this: a strike scores ten plus your next two balls, and a spare scores ten plus your next ball. Three strikes in a row is called a turkey, and twelve in a row gives you a perfect game of 300. Don't worry, the screen takes care of the sums.

If you're bringing the family, Meadowhall can be an all-day outing. Book your lane, plan your food stop, and give younger children a breather between shopping and bowling. Keep shopping bags tucked away so nobody trips while bowling.

If you'd like some outdoor time nearby, Rother Valley Country Park, south-east of Sheffield, offers lakes, walking trails and watersports, while Clifton Park in Rotherham has a museum, play areas and plenty of space to run about. Both make a nice contrast to a day under the shopping centre's roof, and they're easy to combine with a visit to the lanes.
